title: Permanent data erasure
description: Permanently erase an organisation's data; every erasure needs two administrators and cannot be undone.

dualAuth.bannerTitle: A second administrator is always required
dualAuth.bannerText: Every erasure requires two different administrators. The person who requests it cannot approve it. An active legal hold blocks any erasure.
dualAuth.searchPlaceholder: Search by organisation, who requested it, status...
dualAuth.caption: Erasure requests

status.expired: Expired: it must be requested again

requestModal.title: Request permanent erasure
requestModal.description: Propose erasing the data. It becomes permanent only if a second administrator approves it.
requestModal.confirmation: Type CONFIRM DESTRUCTION to confirm the request
requestModal.confirmationHint: Type exactly as shown: CONFIRM DESTRUCTION

approveModal.title: Approve and erase the data for good
approveModal.warning: Warning: this organisation's data and audit records will become unreadable forever. This cannot be undone.
approveModal.holdBlocked: Blocked: an active legal hold applies to this organisation. Remove it first.
approveModal.confirmationPrompt: I confirm I am a different administrator from the requester and authorise permanent erasure.

dualAuth.rejectDesc: The request is closed and nothing is erased.
dualAuth.rejectDefaultReason: Rejected by an administrator in the console.

legalHolds.bannerTitle: Legal holds: data cannot be erased
legalHolds.bannerText: A legal hold prevents any erasure of the organisation's data, including automatic erasure. Only authorised compliance staff can remove it.
legalHolds.searchPlaceholder: Search by organisation, reason, hold number...
legalHolds.caption: Legal holds

imposeModal.title: Apply a legal hold
imposeModal.description: From now on no erasure of the organisation's data will be possible, automatic or manual, until the hold is removed.
imposeModal.reasonHint: For example a case number or court order

releaseModal.title: Remove the legal hold?
releaseModal.description: Once the hold is removed, erasures for this organisation become possible again. Continue?

dms.title: Automatic erasure if the owner disappears
dms.description: If the owner does not confirm they are still there within the set time, all network data is erased automatically. This cannot be undone.
dms.heartbeatDesc: Enter the owner's main password to restart the countdown.
dms.heartbeatDone: Heartbeat confirmed. The countdown has restarted.
dms.emergencyTitle: Immediate erasure of the whole network
dms.emergencyDesc: Permanently erases all organisations' data, in databases and caches, right away. This cannot be undone.

emergencyModal.title: Erase all network data?
emergencyModal.warning: All organisations' data on the network will be erased forever. This cannot be undone.
emergencyModal.phrasePrompt: Type exactly DESTROY EVERYTHING PERMANENTLY to confirm:
emergencyModal.phraseHint: Type exactly as shown: DESTROY EVERYTHING PERMANENTLY

purge.phraseMismatch: Type exactly DESTROY EVERYTHING PERMANENTLY to confirm.

errors.request: The request was not sent. Check the fields and try again.
errors.approve: Approval failed. Try again. If it keeps happening, tell the security lead.
errors.impose: The legal hold was not applied. Try again.
errors.release: The legal hold was not removed. Try again.
errors.reject: The request was not rejected. Try again.
errors.passphrase: Owner password is incorrect. Try again.
errors.purge: The server refused the erasure. Check the password and try again.
errors.phraseMismatch: The phrase does not match. Type exactly CONFIRM DESTRUCTION.
errors.certifyRequired: Tick the box to confirm you are a different administrator.
errors.reasonRequired: Enter the legal reason or order number.
